title: rabdosia trichocarpa f. erythrantha
intro: Rabdosia trichocarpa f. erythrantha, commonly known as Himalayan Cordyceps or Himalayan Cordyceps Mushroom, is a type of plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rabdosia trichocarpa f. erythrantha include stimulating the immune system, improving cardiovascular health, and potentially aiding in the management of diabetes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
